title: Turzx 3.5″ screen
summary: {n, plural, one {# active view} other {# active views}} · full cycle {min} min {sec} s
saved: Turzx updated — the screen follows in a few seconds

mirror.title: Live mirror
mirror.alt: Current content of the Turzx screen
mirror.offline: The renderer is not running (task vmui-turzx) — nothing to show.

views.title: Views
views.hint: Order, dwell time, skin and background for each one. Tap a row to configure it.

weather.label: Weather
weather.description: Animated icon, temperature, wind, pressure, sunrise/sunset.

home.label: Home
home.description: Door, presence, ACs, lights that are on.

pc.label: PC
pc.description: CPU / GPU / RAM with arcs and a sparkline.

pi.label: Raspberry Pi
pi.description: Home server CPU / temperature / RAM, disk, network, throttling.

media.label: Now playing
media.description: What is playing now, with cover art and scrolling titles.

lists.label: Lists
lists.description: Shopping and to-do lists from HA.

fx.label: BNR rates
fx.description: EUR/USD/GBP in RON with the 30-day trend.

crypto.label: Crypto
crypto.description: CoinGecko prices with the 24 h change.

photo.label: Photo / Art
photo.description: One full-screen image with title and credit.

fleet.label: Virtual machines
fleet.description: VMs from vmui: state, RAM, CPU.

climate.label: Climate 24 h
climate.description: Temperature and humidity chart over the last 24 h.

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Upcoming events from HA calendars, with a countdown.

pomodoro.label: Pomodoro
pomodoro.description: Focus timer controlled from /home. Visible only while running.

network.label: Network
network.description: Ping, up/down traffic, Tailscale peers online.

quote.label: Quote
quote.description: One quote a day, typographic, over art.

ambient.label: Ambient (night)
ambient.description: Just the background and a small clock. Active automatically during night hours.

copilot.label: Copilot agents
copilot.description: Active agent sessions on the PC, their repo, last message, turns today.

focus.label: Focus
focus.description: Active window and for how long, plus how the day split: code / browser / media / other.

anniversaries.label: Anniversaries
anniversaries.description: Birthdays and yearly anniversaries, with age and days left.

nutrition.label: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Calories and macros today vs. target (Mifflin-St Jeor from the scale weight), today's meals, streak, coach. Meals come from the codai assistant on the phone.

health.label: Health
health.description: Steps, heart rate, sleep, SpO2, weight from Samsung Health via Health Connect (the HA app on the phone).

energy.label: Energy
energy.description: Power now and kWh today from HA sensors, estimated cost.

notify.title: Phone notifications
notify.hint: A card with the app, sender and message over the current view, for a few seconds. Source: the “Last notification” sensor from Home Assistant Companion (S25).
notify.presenceOnly: Only when I am at the desk
notify.presenceOnlyHint: Requires the desk presence sensor to see me.
notify.showTextHintOn: The card includes the message body.
notify.appsHint: The list must match the Companion allow list.
notify.otherPackagesPlaceholder: other Android packages, one per line (e.g. com.example.app)

background.title: Global background
background.hint: For views without their own background.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro
pomodoro.idle: off — shows on screen only while running

currencies.label: Currencies
currencies.hint: ISO codes, e.g. EUR USD GBP CHF XAU (gold, RON/gram)

holdings.label: Portfolio
holdings.hint: one line: id amount → shows total value and Δ today

people.label: People
people.hint: one line: YYYY-MM-DD Name (the year = birth year, for the age)

device.label: HA device slug
device.hint: prefix of the sensor.SLUG_heart_rate etc. entities

birthDate.label: Date of birth
birthDate.hint: YYYY-MM-DD; with the height it gives BMI, fat, water, muscle (Deurenberg/Hume/Boer estimates — the OKOK scale pads are decorative)

entities.label: Power sensors (entity_id)
entities.hint: empty = every sensor with device_class power/energy

glass.label: Glass
glass.description: Translucent panes over a photo background.

folder.label: Folder local
folder.description: Images from a folder on this PC.

apod.label: NASA APOD
apod.description: NASA's astronomy picture of the day.

commons.label: Wikimedia Commons
commons.description: Picture of the day on Commons.
